postures.definition: County issues a mover-specific credential (permit, registration, and/or license/decal) with identity that may be public or PRA-gated.
County regulates mover conduct by ordinance without a separate public mover credential program (e.g., Monitoring vs Licensing).

invariants: Model remains valid when credential row_count = 0
Ordinance posture is always recorded even for CREDENTIAL_BASED counties
LBT or general business tax is never a substitute posture for mover credential
State HHG authority remains a separate jurisdiction layer
